description: Header file defining the FramebufferSurface class, which manages framebuffer-based display surfaces in Android's SurfaceFlinger, including buffer management, frame processing, and interaction with hardware composer.

classes.name: FramebufferSurface
classes.description: A class that manages framebuffer surfaces for display output, handling buffer lifecycle, frame rendering, resizing, and interaction with hardware composer.

methods.name: FramebufferSurface
methods.description: Constructor initializing the framebuffer surface with hardware composer, display ID, buffer consumer, size, and maximum size.

methods.name: beginFrame
methods.description: Starts processing a new frame, possibly requiring re-composition.

methods.name: prepareFrame
methods.description: Prepares the frame for display based on the specified composition type.

methods.name: advanceFrame
methods.description: Advances to the next frame in the rendering pipeline.

methods.name: onFrameCommitted
methods.description: Callback invoked after a frame has been committed.

methods.name: dumpAsString
methods.description: Outputs the current state of the framebuffer surface as a string.

methods.name: resizeBuffers
methods.description: Resizes the buffers to a new size.

methods.name: getClientTargetAcquireFence
methods.description: Returns the fence associated with acquiring the current client target buffer.

methods.name: limitSize
methods.description: Limits the size of the framebuffer based on maximum size constraints.

methods.name: limitSizeInternal
methods.description: Internal static method to limit size based on maximum size.

methods.name: freeBufferLocked
methods.description: Frees the buffer at the specified slot index.

methods.name: dumpLocked
methods.description: Outputs the internal state of the object for debugging.
